executive_assessment.text: SCD reports recurrent floods, landslides, erosion and storms threaten lives, livelihoods, the airport and primary roads concentrated along the coast.
NDC reports December 2021-February 2022 floods and landslides damaged infrastructure, agriculture and WASH; recovery cost $37.5m, about 7% of 2022 GDP.
